info.name: Workday Security Workday Identity Management API

description.content:
Manage user identities, Workday account signons, and access permissions within the Workday platform. Provides operations for tracking authenticated signon activity, identifying unauthorized authentication attempts, and managing user account credentials. This API includes both SOAP and REST interfaces for retrieving signon history and monitoring identity-related security events.
